about: Phone photo of a monitor showing a Tunic manual card ('Ringing the West Bell', manual page 28, whose transcription reads: 'Can you see the bell but not reach it? Try going to the West Garden. Via the Dark Tomb.'; 'West Garden' and 'Dark Tomb' are printed in English). 480x640, blurrier, half covered by a shadow and a finger: the hardest of the set. One junk line is tolerated.
